== Description ==

[[Apollo Chu]] (front left, blue SpongeBob tee, curly hair), [[Benji Chu]] (front center standing, navy #99 Judge jersey, black SWCCG cap), [[Steve Harpster]] (front table right-back, white hair, glasses, black jacket), [[Chris Wirfs]] (front table right-front, black Solo tee, red shorts, glasses), [[Hayes Hunter]] (standing center, tall, dark grey shirt, jeans), [[Justin Miyashiro]] (standing right, black graphic tee, arms crossed, glasses), [[AJ Hatoum]] (standing right foreground (back), olive jacket, khaki pants), and [[Garrett Larson]] (stream table far right, pink cap, beard) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 3 October 2025.
